title: Short delivery landing the payable in the AP_MANAGER band
rationale_key_facts: The invoice bills all 60 kits but only 52 were received and accepted.
One defect only, so clause 11 does not force escalation.
$17,888.00 falls in the $10,000.01-$25,000.00 band, so the approver is the AP_MANAGER, not the clerk.
